claim: The door and spot-count outboxes obey ADR 0241 (OD-203 (a) and (b); the founder, 2026-09-29: offline changes "always ends up uh, with our database"). spotCountOutbox: no attempt ceiling (MAX_ATTEMPTS gone); a permanent 4xx parks the count as not sent (kept, shown by the app-wide strip), a transient failure (incl. 401) is retried on the next flush; it sends only entries visible to the session's person and house and parks a legacy count naming no house as unowned. doorOutbox: no attempt ceiling for transient failures (was 8, then a pinned drop); a 401 is kept for the same person's next sign-in; only a permanent refusal (isPermanentRefusal) still ends in ADR 0140's pinned drop record, reason auth for 403 and refused otherwise; it never sends an entry not visible to the session or naming no house. Both outboxes re-read the session before every send, so a house switch in the middle of a flush leaves the rest queued for its own house (spotCountOutbox.test.ts and doorOutbox.test.ts 'a house switch in the middle of a flush'; hoisting the read back out of the loop fails both, measured). ChooseHouse and VerifyEmail navigate to sign-in only when logout() returns true. Behaviour: spotCountOutbox.test.ts (7, all fail on origin/main's outbox), doorOutbox.test.ts (4 fail on main's outbox), ChooseHouse.test.tsx cancel case (fails on main's page). The verify pins the anchors; the specs are the behaviour.
